TITLE: Cybernetics in Two Parts
DESCRIPTION: A too-short explainer that only manages two segments.
TAGS: cybernetics, history, science

### Segment 1: Origins
LINES:
- Norbert Wiener, 1948
NARRATION: Cybernetics began with Norbert Wiener's 1948 book of the same name.

### Segment 2: Legacy
LINES:
- Feedback loops everywhere
NARRATION: Its ideas about feedback now underpin control theory and much of modern computing.
